title: Add local/test auth bootstrap path
problem: Authenticated smoke flows require a manual browser login.
why_it_matters: The harness cannot run non-interactive proof for authenticated behavior.
recommended_change: Add a local/test-only auth provider or middleware that can create a session for a seeded fixture user.
safety_requirements: Disabled unless explicit local/test profile is active
Fails startup if enabled in production
Does not weaken production auth path
Covered by tests proving production profile rejects the bypass
proof_unblocked: L3 authenticated runtime interaction, possibly L4 with side-effect check
